{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates('patient_id')

# Compute response rates by arm and severity
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'], values=df_dedup['responded'], aggfunc='mean')

# Extract control and treatment response rates for each severity level
control_mild = crosstab.loc['control', 'mild']
control_moderate = crosstab.loc['control', 'moderate']
control_severe = crosstab.loc['control', 'severe']

treatment_mild = crosstab.loc['treatment', 'mild']
treatment_moderate = crosstab.loc['treatment', 'moderate']
treatment_severe = crosstab.loc['treatment', 'severe']

# Compute stratum-specific differences: treatment - control
diff_mild = treatment_mild - control_mild
diff_moderate = treatment_moderate - control_moderate
diff_severe = treatment_severe - control_severe

# Compute control arm counts per severity
control_counts = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['severity'].value_counts()
total_control = control_counts.sum()

# Compute weights: control counts divided by total control
w_mild = control_counts['mild'] / total_control
w_moderate = control_counts['moderate'] / total_control
w_severe = control_counts['severe'] / total_control

# Compute weighted average difference
weighted_diff = diff_mild * w_mild + diff_moderate * w_moderate + diff_severe * w_severe

# Print ALL values that will be used in evidence — no truncation
print('diff_mild:', diff_mild)
print('diff_moderate:', diff_moderate)
print('diff_severe:', diff_severe)
print('w_mild:', w_mild)
print('w_moderate:', w_moderate)
print('w_severe:', w_severe)
print('weighted_diff:', weighted_diff)"}
